prompt:
SUMMARY: A high swept-back crown of rope twists gathered into a long braid; a fitted base layer with flowing panels of projected light floating around her like a gown — a silhouette spread in light; Four projected skirt panels derive from arched load-bearing frames at the waist, each splitting into triangulated girders and tapering upward into one beacon clasp.; heart-shaped face; composed and self-assured.
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult French woman — the personification of the iron lattice tower on the Champ de Mars, a landmark of the city of Paris — one woman who IS the iron lattice tower on the Champ de Mars as it stands in this world. She is the subject of the picture; her costume, body, props and light carry the city's symbols and this world's marks, and the city behind her only supports her.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the description below, not a generic pretty face.
Face proportions: Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.

2. CHARACTER
Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.
Face — her own: a regal, imperious haughtiness; bronze-brown skin; heart-shaped face; soft almond eyes with gently lowered outer corners; steel-blue eyes; gently arched, slender brows; a nose with a slightly upturned tip; medium-full lips of natural width.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.
Body and hair: willowy and long-limbed with soft curves — a full bust, rounded hips and a slender waist build; A high swept-back crown of rope twists gathered into a long braid; rose-gold hair.
Expression: a composed, self-assured look.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — CYBERPUNK
Costume: far-future techwear cut to the outfit silhouette below — smart fabric, chrome and glossy vinyl, fine straps and glowing light lines, glowing tattoo lines and cybernetic implants on her skin, holographic jewelry; sign light reflected on her face.
City motif: a slim exoskeleton frame of bronze-gold lines that cross like lattice girders as they climb her body, wide at her hips and drawing narrow toward her shoulders like the tower, soft rings of signal light rippling out from her shoulders, and a tiny lattice-tower transmitter hooked over one ear.
World marks on her: glowing neon tattoos; cybernetic implants; reflective trim catching the light; sign light reflected on her face; holographic jewelry; fiber-optic glowing hair strands; chrome and glossy vinyl; magenta and cyan glow; soft holographic light shimmering across her skin and clothes; techwear traced with glowing light lines; far-future smart fabric rippling with soft light patterns.
Silhouette: a fitted base layer with flowing panels of projected light floating around her like a gown — a silhouette spread in light. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the city motif, the world marks and the palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.
Design idea: Four projected skirt panels derive from arched load-bearing frames at the waist, each splitting into triangulated girders and tapering upward into one beacon clasp.
Colours: zinc-roof blue-grey, wrought-iron bronze, rose-window red — one of these as her accent colour.
Prop: in one hand she holds a slender antenna wand of bronze lattice whose tip sends out slow rings of soft light like ripples; her other hand is free.
Exposure (bold): her techwear opens to show skin where its silhouette allows — bare shoulders and midriff or a deep neckline with natural cleavage, and bare legs, traced with glowing tattoo lines. Intimate areas covered.

4. SCENE
World: Paris two centuries from now, a far-future megacity: the old iron lattice tower kept whole as a great transmitting antenna, every girder wound with threads of light that pulse outward in rings of soft radiance carrying the city's time signal to the sky and the orbiting stations beyond, a floating rink of light on its first level, a signal chamber where the old laboratories stood at its summit, and white glass towers glowing far across the river under a clear indigo night.
This card: in the signal chamber at the summit where the old laboratories stood, antique brass instruments kept beside floating panes of light and rings of signal light pulsing out through the windows.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Stance and hands: She holds the wand upright away from her silhouette, her other hand open at waist level. Both hands remain clearly visible.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text, lettering or numbers anywhere in the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: second character, living creature, logo, watermark, speech bubble, frame border, text, lettering, numbers anywhere in the picture, a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
